newsitem.title: USA: Witco Louisiana plant fire under control.
newsitem.headline: Witco Louisiana plant fire under control.

text.p: Witco Corp said a fire on Wednesday at its Gretna, La., chemical plant near New Orleans was under control and there was only "modest damage" to the facility.
No production units at the plant were damaged. There were no injuries and all workers at the plant had been accounted for, a spokesman for the Greenwich, Conn.-based company said.
"I think some fuel oil ignited that was being transferred, but we're not sure yet," the Witco spokesman said.
A small building housing a compressor unit was damaged in the blaze, he said.
Details on what the plant produces were not immediately available. Witco manufactures specialty chemicals and petroleum products for industrial and consumer uses.
Thick black smoke could be seen rising from the plant, which is located across the Mississippi River from the historic French Quarter, city police said.
